about.summary: Software Engineer and Computer Science and Engineering graduate from the German University in Cairo, with an A+ Bachelor's degree. I have shipped full-stack applications, backend microservices, data pipelines, and AI/ML systems across banking, logistics, and enterprise software, working across the complete software development life cycle (SDLC) in Agile/Scrum teams. My work spans REST and GraphQL API design, distributed systems, cloud deployment (GCP, AWS), and applied machine learning from production LLM pipelines to computer vision research. I write unit and integration tests as a habit, not an afterthought, and care about code the next engineer can actually read.

thesis.title: Vision Transformer Framework for Vehicle Intention Prediction
thesis.description: Reproduced Uber's CNN baseline from the original paper, retrained it on the public Argoverse 2 autonomous driving dataset, and trained a Vision Transformer (ViT) under identical conditions to benchmark both architectures on vehicle maneuver/intention prediction. At matched training checkpoints, the ViT outperformed the CNN baseline by 52.9%.

bullets: Developing Spring Boot microservices for the Bill Payments team, integrating external billers and service providers through WSO2 to enable secure bill payment processing backed by PostgreSQL.

Refactored and consolidated WhatsApp, SMS, and email channels into a single modular TypeScript backend service using inheritance and polymorphism, enabling new channels to be added without modifying existing integrations, reducing code duplication, and improving maintainability.

Built a 54-test black-box integration test suite using Vitest and Supertest, exercising the communication service over HTTP while validating MongoDB side effects and outbound Graph API calls, enabling reliable regression testing and CI integration.

Built an embedded Shopify app using Remix, React, and Node.js that connects merchant storefronts to a logistics backend via Shopify Webhooks and the GraphQL Admin API, processing real-time order events across multiple merchant accounts.
Designed and shipped a bulk waybill generation feature that automated the end-to-end shipment creation workflow, reducing manual processing time by 80%.
Developed backend features for a courier management service built with Bun, Hono, Clerk, MongoDB, and Next.js, supporting real-time order tracking and courier dispatch.

Built a customer communication service on top of the Meta Cloud API for inbound/outbound messaging, stateful conversation workflows, and HMAC-verified webhooks, enabling automated customer notifications and order confirmations.
Built scalable Spring Boot microservices for a virtual banking platform, integrating Apache Kafka for asynchronous event-driven messaging and WSO2 API Gateway for secure external API routing.

Developed the REST API layer for mobile and web banking clients, implementing OAuth 2.0 authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and request validation following secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.
Integrated Keycloak single sign-on (SSO) into OpenKM, centralizing identity and access management within a Dockerized MSSQL environment.
Built automated backup and disaster recovery pipelines using Rclone to minimize data-loss risk and support compliance requirements.
Authored deployment and onboarding documentation that became the team's standard reference, reducing new-engineer ramp-up time by 60%.
Designed and built an automated quality tracking system in VBA (Excel and Access), replacing a manual process and reducing data entry time by 70% while improving reporting accuracy.
Developed a customer survey platform using Java, XHTML, and MySQL that enabled branch teams to collect, store, and review structured customer feedback.
Gained hands-on experience with IBM DataPower API Gateway, ACH payment processing workflows, and enterprise banking security protocols.
Developed a full-stack MERN banking application featuring user authentication, account management, and transaction history, delivering the project within a one-month sprint.

projects.title: Vision Transformer for Autonomous Vehicle Intention Prediction
projects.description: Reproduced Uber's CNN baseline and trained a Vision Transformer (ViT) on Argoverse 2 to benchmark vehicle maneuver prediction, with the ViT outperforming by 52.9%.
bullets: Reproduced Uber's CNN baseline from the original paper, retrained it on the public Argoverse 2 autonomous driving dataset, and trained a Vision Transformer (ViT) under identical conditions to benchmark both architectures on vehicle maneuver/intention prediction.

Designed and implemented the full data preprocessing, temporal feature extraction, model training, and evaluation pipeline for both architectures; at matched training checkpoints, the ViT outperformed the CNN baseline by 52.9%.
Conducted comparative model benchmarking and error analysis to validate results against published research, applying rigorous experiment tracking and reproducibility practices.

projects.title: Massively Scalable Food Delivery Platform (Talabat-like)
projects.description: Distributed, fault-tolerant food delivery backend built as independently deployable microservices for customers, restaurants, and drivers.
bullets: Contributed to a distributed, fault-tolerant food delivery backend built as independently deployable microservices for customers, restaurants, and drivers; owned the User Service end to end — JWT authentication, BCrypt password hashing, and role-based access control.

Replaced shared-table SQL joins with OpenFeign clients for inter-service communication, published domain events over RabbitMQ, and wrote idempotent Saga-pattern consumers to update user stats on order completion and cancellation, backed by a dead-letter queue (DLQ) with three-attempt retry for fault tolerance.

Deployed the User Service on Kubernetes with health/readiness probes and a headless StatefulSet for Postgres; added Prometheus metrics with a Grafana dashboard and structured Loki logs with MDC fields for full observability.

projects.title: Agentic NDA Contract Analysis System
projects.description: Agentic contract review pipeline with reasoning, policy, orchestration, and logging components — an applied RAG and agentic workflow system for legal document analysis.
bullets: Contributed to a 5-member team building an agentic contract review pipeline with reasoning, policy, orchestration, and logging components — an applied retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic workflow system for legal document analysis.

Fine-tuned a Qwen large language model (LLM) using QLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning on the ContractNLI benchmark to classify 17 legal hypotheses per contract as ENTAILED, CONTRADICTED, or NOT MENTIONED.
Built the vector embedding and semantic search layer for retrieval over contract clauses using a vector database, focusing on output reliability and grounding across real-world legal documents.

projects.title: DDoS Mitigation Tool
projects.description: Tool that detects and blocks DDoS attacks in real time.
bullets: Contributed to a tool that detects and blocks DDoS attacks in real time, working as the mitigation engineer on a four-person team.
Built the response engine that watches incoming traffic and automatically steps up from monitoring to rate limiting to blocking IPs as an attack progresses.
Integrated with Linux iptables to drop malicious traffic at the kernel level, with a scoring system to avoid blocking legitimate users.

projects.title: Athletic Tournament Management System
projects.description: Digital tournament management system for GUC students and staff.
bullets: Contributed to the planning phase of a digital tournament management system for GUC students and staff.
Delivered a Project Charter, Scope Statement, and a three-level Work Breakdown Structure with 10+ sub-activities.
Mapped stakeholder interests and set up a Jira board simulation translating WBS elements into epics, tasks, and subtasks with owners and dependencies.

projects.title: Real-Time Stock Analytics Platform
projects.description: End-to-end data engineering pipeline using Apache Airflow for orchestration and Apache Kafka with PySpark for real-time market data stream processing.
bullets: Contributed to an end-to-end data engineering pipeline using Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration and Apache Kafka with PySpark for real-time market data stream processing.
Stored processed data in PostgreSQL and helped integrate a LangChain Text-to-SQL agent for natural language querying over the warehouse; fully containerized with Docker and cloud-deployed.
Built interactive Apache Superset dashboards to visualize streaming market data and pipeline health metrics for data-driven monitoring.

projects.title: Graph-RAG Travel Assistant
projects.description: Knowledge graph from 50,000+ hotel reviews with hybrid retrieval combining vector similarity search and Cypher-based graph traversal.
bullets: Contributed to a knowledge graph built from 50,000+ hotel reviews with named entity recognition (NER) and a Streamlit frontend for interactive querying.
Helped design a hybrid retrieval layer combining vector similarity search with Cypher-based graph traversal to ground LLM answers in structured data, reducing hallucination.
Added SHAP and LIME explainability (XAI) to the underlying ML models to make recommendations interpretable and auditable.

projects.title: All-in-One Vacation Platform
projects.description: Full-stack travel booking platform with flight/hotel search, promo codes, Stripe payments, and Amadeus live booking integration.
bullets: Contributed to a full-stack travel booking platform where users can search and book flights and hotels, apply promo codes, and receive personalized recommendations.
Integrated Stripe for payment processing and Amadeus for live flight and hotel booking data via third-party API integration.
Worked in an Agile team using Git version control and GitHub for collaboration, contributing across the MERN stack from API design to frontend components.

projects.title: Embedded Auto Lane Detection
projects.description: Real-time lane detection system written in C interfacing directly with hardware drivers on an embedded platform.
bullets: Contributed to a real-time lane detection system written in C that interfaced directly with hardware drivers on an embedded platform, working within tight memory and real-time processing constraints.
Helped implement the image processing and signal processing logic to identify lane boundaries and feed steering signals to the navigation layer.
Tested the system under varying lighting and road conditions to validate detection reliability and robustness.

projects.title: University Academic System and Portal
projects.description: Academic management system with a normalized relational database schema and 50+ stored procedures, views, triggers, and functions.
bullets: Contributed to an academic management system with a normalized relational database schema and 50+ stored procedures, views, triggers, and functions.
Automated registration, graduation checks, and academic probation rules at the database layer to enforce business logic consistently across the application.
Helped build a role-based web portal with separate views and permissions for students, advisors, and administrators.

projects.title: Donation Ecosystem Platform

bullets: Contributed to a platform connecting donors with NGOs, taking part in requirements gathering across stakeholder groups and overall system design.
Helped deliver a responsive, accessible React prototype covering donor registration, campaign browsing, and NGO profiles, following web accessibility (WCAG) standards.
Coordinated with teammates to align reusable, component-based UI architecture with the agreed data model and user flows.

projects.title: The Last of Us: Legacy Game Engine
projects.description: Turn-based survival game in Java applying OOP principles and MVC software architecture.
bullets: Contributed to a turn-based survival game in Java applying object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and MVC software architecture.
Helped build the core game loop, grid-based map, and entity interaction system covering players, enemies, and collectibles.
Implemented a custom GUI and thorough exception handling to keep game state consistent across edge cases.
